en.dr-ali-peiravi: 11-1 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash’ari, on the authority of Ali ibn Muhammad, on the authority of Suleiman ibn Zyad al-Minqari, on the authority of Amr ibn Shimr, on the authority of Isma’il ibn al-Sadi, on the authority of Abdul Rahman ibn Sabit al-Qurashi, on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, “Regarding what God said about Joseph (MGB)we read the following in the Holy Quran, ‘I did see eleven stars and the sun and the moon: I saw them prostrate themselves to me![12:4]’

Then he started to name those stars: that were Al-Tariq, Jirban, Al-Zial, Zul-Kanafan, Zul-Qar’e, Qabis, Vas’sab, Amoodan, Faylaq, Misbah, Al-Zaruh, Al-Zia’e and Al-Nur implying the sun and the moon. All the stars are encompassed by the sky.”
